dominant_strengths: High-fidelity recreation of Linear's signature dark UI with accurate type hierarchy, iconography, and inline code token styling.
Floating Copilot panel layered convincingly over the issue activity stream, demonstrating a believable agentic workflow integration.
Logo strip at bottom uses consistent monochrome treatment, reinforcing premium enterprise positioning without visual noise.
dominant_weaknesses: Copilot chat panel overlaps the right-side metadata column awkwardly, creating z-index ambiguity and obscuring labels/assignee context.
The black band beneath the app screenshot and abrupt transition to the logo wall feels like two pages stitched together, breaking flow.
Activity feed lacks micro-rhythm: avatars, timestamps, and nested replies share similar weight, flattening the information hierarchy.
fix_priorities: Reposition or dock the Copilot panel so it doesn't crash into the sidebar metadata; add a subtle backdrop dim for focus.
Bridge the screenshot-to-logos transition with a gradient, caption, or section header to establish narrative continuity.
Differentiate activity event types via color-coded icons or muted secondary text to restore scannability.
rationale.norman_balance: Behavioral clarity leads via faithful product mechanics, visceral polish is solid but reflective wow is muted by a generic agent-in-Linear narrative.
rationale.intent_fit: Clearly communicates a Linear feature page showcasing Copilot agent integration, though the composition reads more as a product screenshot than a crafted marketing moment.
